shows: Voyager 2 true-color view (1986): the smooth pale cyan-turquoise globe and soft limb darkening; the base color of the planet
JWST NIRCam (2023): bright white polar cap, glowing limb, concentric thin ring system seen nearly face-on with the bright epsilon ring, small bright storms
Keck adaptive-optics infrared (2012): soft latitudinal banding, bright cloud streaks and small storms, thin rings standing nearly vertical across the disc

credit: NASA, ESA, STScI, A. Simon (NASA-GSFC), M. H. Wong (UC Berkeley), J. DePasquale (STScI)
shows: Hubble WFC3 (2022): pale cyan disc with a large bright north polar cap/haze, faint outer rings
